lines.text: I'm with your grandparents all day, so you always know how they're doing.
Your mom's walks, her lunch, tea with Ruth. No need to call and interrupt.
Need me to bring her something? Just let me know.
I'll take it right to her, and give her your note.
And when you miss her, I can bring you right to her.
At the end of the day, I'll tell you how it went.
Every walk, every glass of water. I remember the little things, so you don't have to wonder.
